description: 20 additional verified publisher-hosted audio productions after the previous 20: ten Moraband-inspired (five scripted dramas, five tabletop actual plays), then ten Shard-Moon-inspired (five scripted dramas, five actual plays). All are cross-genre creative references, NOT Star Wars canon. No private campaign secrets are published.

terms: 01 - A Body In A New Place
entries.learning: Occult recordings, hidden dimensions, investigative evidence and institutional secrets.
Mystery-first play with unreliable clues, grounded characters and mounting supernatural dread.

terms: Chapter 1: Let Me Speak First Of Revelations
entries.learning: Forbidden religions, devotion, doctrinal conflicts and disturbing ritual costs.
Inheritance, old obligations, family secrets and investigation of a ritual curse.
Ancient buried powers, corrupting bargains and communities living around forbidden places.

terms: Shards of San Francisco - Episode One
entries.learning: Character-led Gothic investigation and the personal price of ancient supernatural power.

terms: The Case of Charles Dexter Ward: Episode 1
entries.learning: Documentary-style mystery, hidden cult histories and clues that change their meaning.
An isolated investigation where an authority's orders conceal dangerous occult machinery.

terms: Episode 101 - A Tale of Two Tapes Part I
entries.learning: A skeptical investigator uncovers disputed paranormal evidence and an escalating conspiracy.

terms: Pisco Sour | Time For Chaos S1 E2
entries.learning: Character-driven investigation during an expedition into a dangerous ancient conspiracy; opening in-character play rather than character creation.
Two xenoarchaeologists explore a lost civilization on a hostile world; strong expedition continuity.
A team visits a remote asteroid relay after a mysterious death; environmental systems and clues.
A controlled enclosed habitat with identity, surveillance and unexplained experiments.
A science-fiction crew evaluates a catastrophic dimensional anomaly and its consequences.
A highly controlled artificial moon, corporate AI, human subjects and ominous facility messaging.

entries.show: Cosmic Crit: A Starfinder Actual Play Podcast
terms: Guilt of the Grave World | 010: Orb Your Enthusiasm
entries.learning: Exploration of a damaged Station Alpha arcane laboratory, with stranded people, strange experiments and negotiated threats.
First-light experimental propulsion flight becomes survival science when testing goes wrong; opening fictional chapter, not creator commentary.
Team members respond to an anomalous corporate site where everyday procedures mask danger.
Research personnel confront revived prehistoric creatures and discoveries beneath a remote station.
A corporation sends a team to a lifeless anomaly world; decisions balance survival and exploitation.
